component.name: openprocessor-frame-engine-native
component.description: C code and CUDA libraries in the native frame engine image that no package manager lists: Trivy cannot see them in the image. Scanned with `trivy sbom` (see docker/frame-engine-native/Dockerfile).

components.name: libjpeg-turbo
components.description: built static from the release tarball in the build stage (LIBJPEG_TURBO_VERSION)

components.name: lcms2
components.description: vendored by the lcms2-sys crate (native/Cargo.lock), linked static; the version Pillow 13.0.0 bundles

components.name: nvjpeg
components.description: libnvjpeg.so from NVIDIA's wheel, copied to /opt/nvidia/lib (pin in docker/frame-engine/requirements.txt)

components.name: nvrtc
components.description: libnvrtc and its builtins from NVIDIA's wheel, copied to /opt/nvidia/lib

components.name: cuda-runtime
components.description: libcudart from NVIDIA's wheel, copied to /opt/nvidia/lib
